remarks: Set on a quiet cul-de-sac, this graceful 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Spanish Mediterranean home (2,552 sq ft) enjoys a serene setting moments from Glen A. Wilson High School, Wedgeworth Elementary, and Cedarlane Academy — the calm of home, with schools close at hand. The main level unfolds with ease: a sunlit living room, a family room warmed by a cozy fireplace, and a powder room for guests. Upstairs, four serene bedrooms and two full baths, crowned by a grand bonus room with its own balcony — a sun-washed retreat for morning yoga, a quiet study, or long, unhurried evenings together.
